drawn.chart: Electric · Sep 2025 — Aug 2026 · a value axis 0 · 2,000 · 4,000 · 6,000 · 8,000 · the caption 'kWh a month' · one labelled bar per month, Sep 25 … Aug 26
drawn.elsewhereNote: The service picker is a DROPDOWN and not the drawn chips — PO ruling 2026-09-07, 'can you do dropdown - for utility services - dyamically so that user can see one data at a time'. Reported, not taken silently.

elsewhere.Electric / Water / All chips: a DROPDOWN instead, one service at a time — PO ruling 2026-09-07, "can you do dropdown - for utility services - dyamically so that user can see one data at a time". A later ruling beats an earlier drawing; the chips are not built.
elsewhere.This month vs last (the label): reads "Vs last month", three words — B14 rule 33 caps a LABEL at three words and rule 38 gives our own rules the construction. The FIGURE is the drawn one.

groups.heading: MONTH BY MONTH
groups.tableNote: One column per SERVICE sits between MONTH and READ ON — the drawing shows ELECTRIC and WATER because its account holds two. The columns are payload.services and are never typed out (hard-won law 2), so they are not listed here as fixed names.

elsewhere.READ ON (the value): no source — monthly_usage stores source_read_ids and no read date, and usage_payload serves computed_at, which is when the FIGURE was worked out. Each cell states the absence. DEF-CUS-5146.
elsewhere.SOURCE (the read method): half served — an estimated month says Estimated (BR-MET-106); the read METHOD behind an ordinary month is not served and the cell states it. DEF-CUS-5146.
